correctness.rationale: Kallel--Sjerve identify based third finite-subset homology of a suspension with reduced symmetric-square homology. The reduced symmetric square of a finite wedge splits into diagonal reduced squares and pairwise smash products. For sphere summands, the diagonal homology is the shifted homology of real projective space, while reversing an off-diagonal smash has degree \((-1)^d\). These facts give every group, degree, and \(S_n\)-action in the claim. Boundary cases \(d=1,2\) are included explicitly, and the replay verifies the group-action consequences through \(n=7,d=6\).

value.rationale: This is a complete natural equivariant classification for a canonical two-parameter family, not a numerical slice. It reveals a parity effect invisible to ordinary homology: the pair-indexed free top classes are a genuine permutation lattice in even sphere dimension and an exterior-square lattice in odd dimension, while all projective-space torsion layers transform as coordinate permutations. The formula supplies reusable representation data for equivariant finite-subset constructions.
